result_text:
`all_files.zip` now packages the scope file lists under the names they were written with, taken from the configured aspect names. I only compiled the `reports` module (no errors). I didn't run any tests, and I didn't try a renamed-aspect config.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the zip step near the end of the export. It no longer reads fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals. It builds each file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is the same call the loose text files use. The order stays main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With the aspect renamed to "buildAndDeployment", the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Because `all_files.zip` no longer throws, `git-history.zip` is written as before when a `git-history.txt` exists.

I didn't commit anything.
